description: This file defines the I18NLanguageModel class, which implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits to handle serialization of an I18NLanguage entity in the context of the OrangeHRM system. It sets up entity reference, filters, and attribute mappings.

classes.name: I18NLanguageModel
classes.description: A model class representing the internationalization language entity, supports normalization and serialization for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an I18NLanguage entity and sets filter and attribute configurations.
